211: O Nanak, are fortunate, and their faces shine bright. ॥4॥3॥141॥
O my soul, the support of God's Name is what helps you.
ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨੋ; ਤਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਮ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In every other effort made for Maya lies the danger of spiritual death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By no other effort is God found.
Only by great good fortune can one remember God. ॥1॥
Though we win honour in the world through a hundred thousand clever ploys,
hereafter they bring not a grain of respect. ॥2॥
Religious deeds done in a way that feeds a proud intellect
are like houses of sand washed away by the flood. ॥3॥
The person on whom God, the source of mercy, shows grace,
O Nanak, receives the Name in the Guru's company. ॥4॥4॥142॥
I am a sacrifice to the Name, a hundred thousand times devoted.
ਨਾਮੋ ਹੋ, ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੋ; ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Master's Name, the Name alone, is the support of every life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
You alone have the power to do all and to have beings do it.
You alone are the support of all creatures. ॥1॥
O God, You are the owner of power and of youth.
You are beyond the three qualities, and You are this form made of them. ॥2॥
Here and hereafter You protect all,
but only a rare one grasps this by the Guru's grace. ॥3॥
O God, You know every heart, and You are the wise one.
You alone are Nanak's support and Nanak's strength. ॥4॥5॥143॥
Always remember the Name of God.
ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਭਰਮੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਉ. ਸਾਧੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the company of saints God comes to dwell in the mind, and wandering, attachment and fear are brought under control. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The pandits may read the Vedas, Puranas and Simritis,
but the saints are heard to stand at a higher spiritual place than all. ॥1॥
All other hearts are seen to be gripped by fears;
remembrance has made God's servants free of fear. ॥2॥
Beings wander through the eighty-four lakh births,
but God's devotees are not caught in birth and death. ॥3॥
They no longer lean on strength, intellect or cleverness, and their pride is gone,
O Nanak, who have taken the refuge of God and the Guru. ॥4॥6॥144॥
O my mind, let us remember God's Name and sing His praises.
ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serve God always; meditate on Him with every breath. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the company of the Guru, God comes to dwell in the mind,
and all pain, the darkness of attachment and wandering flee. ॥1॥
Only by the Guru's grace can God's Name be repeated.
That person is not gripped by any pain. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੇ ॥
The one to whom the Guru gives the mantra of God's Name
is saved from the fire of Maya. ॥3॥
O God, be gracious to Nanak,
so that Your Name, O Lord, may dwell in my mind and heart. ॥4॥7॥145॥
Keep repeating the one Name with the tongue.
ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਘਨਾ; ਆਗੈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Here it brings great peace and joy, and hereafter it serves the soul. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Your disease of pride can be cut away.
ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਰਿ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
By the Guru's grace you can enjoy the householder's life and union with God alike. ॥1॥
Whoever has tasted the taste of God's Name,
his thirst for Maya is quenched. ॥2॥
He has found God, the treasure of peace,
ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਨ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
and he no longer runs off anywhere else. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
The one to whom the Guru has given God's Name,
O Nanak, every fear of his has gone. ॥4॥8॥146॥
212: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥
Whoever forgets God's Name, pain comes and grips him.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਹਿ; ਸੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who remember God in the company of the holy become rich in virtues and deep of heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one in whose heart, through the Guru, the understanding of remembrance arises
ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਤਲ; ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥
holds the nine treasures and all powers in the palms of his hands. ॥1॥
Those who form a deep bond with God, the Master of all treasures,
One who has come close to the Creator
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Those in whose heart's home the wealth of God's Name dwells:
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪੭॥
says Nanak, in their company every pain flees. ॥4॥9॥147॥
Your pride is great, but what you have to show for it is small.
You have no lasting place here, yet your grip on Maya is very strong. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੇਬਰਜਤ, ਬੇਦ ਸੰਤਨਾ; ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ. ਰੇ ਹਿਤਨੋ ॥
The very thing the Vedas and the saints forbid is the thing you love.
ਹਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਜੂਆ ਬਿਧੇ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਲੈ. ਜਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥
You are losing life's game as a gambler loses; lust has taken you in its power and beaten you. ॥1॥
ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗਿ, ਰਿਤਨੋ ॥
You are empty of love for the lovely feet of God, who destroys and sustains all.
ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੈ ਦਿਤਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪੮॥
O Nanak, those in the company of the holy are saved; God, the treasure of grace, has given me this gift. ॥2॥10॥148॥
I am a lowly servant of the Lord who sustains me;
I eat only the grain that God gives. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
that in an instant He can make the creation and make it beautiful. ॥1॥
If it pleases the Lord to be kind to me, I would do His work,
ਗੀਤ ਚਰਿਤ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
and keep singing His praises and songs of His glory. ॥2॥
I have sought the refuge of the Lord's ministers, the saints;
seeing them, my mind takes heart. ॥3॥
I have made the one God my shelter and my support,
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੪੯॥
and, servant Nanak, I am set to God's work of praise. ॥4॥11॥149॥
Is there anyone who can break my pride
ਇਸੁ ਮੀਠੀ ਤੇ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and hold this mind back from this sweet Maya? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ; ਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ. ਸੋ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
A person has lost his sense and searches for what does not last.
ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਕਾਰੀਆ; ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
A pitch-dark night lies over the mind; what way is there to bring the dawn? ॥1॥
ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਹਾਰਿਆ; ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਰੈ ॥
Searching in many ways and wandering, I grew weary.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੫੦॥
Says Nanak: then God showed mercy, and now the company of the holy is my treasure. ॥2॥12॥150॥
O merciful God, You are the jewel that fulfils every wish. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
O supreme God, kind to the poor, by remembering You all comforts come. ॥1॥
ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ; ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ॥ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਸੋ; ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਖਏ ॥੨॥
O Timeless Being, beyond all understanding, hearing Your praise destroys millions of sins. ॥2॥
ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੧॥
O God, treasure of grace, on whomever You show mercy, O Nanak, he remembers Your Name. ॥3॥13॥151॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
O my mind, whoever seeks God's refuge enjoys spiritual joy.
ਜਾ ਦਿਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੈ. ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਤ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The day one forgets the Giver of life and peace, that day goes to waste. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਏਕ ਰੈਣ ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ; ਬਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਆਸ ਬਧਾਏ ॥
You have come as a guest for one night, yet you build hopes of living for ages.
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਪੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ; ਜਿਉ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਏ ॥੧॥
Homes, mansions and wealth, all that is seen, are like the shade of a tree. ॥1॥
ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਪੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ; ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
My body, all my wealth, my gardens and lands, all these places are mine:
ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
caught in this, one forgets the Lord who gave them, and in an instant they belong to others. ॥2॥
213: ਪਹਿਰੈ ਬਾਗਾ. ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ; ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
A person bathes, puts on white clothes and applies perfume and sandal,
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਿਆ; ਜਿਉ ਹਸਤੀ ਨਾਵਾਏ ॥੩॥
but without knowing the fearless, formless Lord it is like washing an elephant. ॥3॥
ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ. ਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ; ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਏ ॥
When God is kind He leads one to the true Guru, and in God's Name are all comforts.
ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਇਆ. ਬੰਧਨ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲੇ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੫੨॥
O Nanak, the one whose bonds the Guru has opened is freed, and he sings God's praises. ॥4॥14॥152॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ. ਸਦ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
O my mind, keep the Guru ever in remembrance.
ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਆ; ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has made the precious human life bear fruit; be a sacrifice to his sight. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਨੁ ਲੇਤਾ; ਤੇਤੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
With every breath and every morsel one takes, let one sing God's praises.
ਜਉ ਹੋਇ ਦੈਆਲੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਤਾ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
Only when one's dear true Guru is kind is this understanding received. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਏ. ਜਮ ਬੰਧ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਹਿ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
O my mind, remembering the Name you are freed from death's bonds and find the joy above all joys.
ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਮਨ ਬੰਛਤ ਫਲ ਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
Serving the true Guru, who gives the Master's Name, one gains the fruit the mind desires. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਟੁ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਤ ਕਰਤਾ; ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
The Creator's Name is your true love, friend and son, O mind; it goes with you always.
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
Take the refuge of your true Guru; the Name is received only from the Guru. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
On whom the kind Guru and God have shown grace, all his anxieties are gone.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ; ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੫੩॥
O Nanak, the one who found joy in singing God's praise has had all his troubles removed. ॥4॥15॥153॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ. ਬਿਰਲੇ ਹੀ ਕੀ; ਬੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In only a rare one is the fire of craving put out. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕ੍ਰੋਰੇ; ਮਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਰੇ ॥ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਹੀ ਕਉ; ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
A person earns millions and gathers more, yet does not restrain the mind, and burns for more and more. ॥1॥
ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਰਕਾਰੀ; ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ॥ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
He has every fond play with his lovely wife, yet sins with another's; he cannot see what is bad and what is good. ॥2॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ, ਭਰਮਤੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ; ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ. ਨਹੀ ਗਾਇਆ ॥ ਮਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਲੁਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
Bound by Maya's many bonds, he wanders and is ruined, and does not praise the treasure of virtues; minds keep burning in vices. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ, ਜੀਵਤ ਸੋਈ ਮਰੈ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਰੈ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਝੀ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੪॥
The one on whom God shows grace stays untouched by Maya while working in the world, and crosses Maya in the company of the holy; O Nanak, that person succeeds at God's door. ॥4॥1॥154॥
ਸਭਹੂ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
God's Name is the highest delight of all beings. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਭੋਗ; ਕਾਹੂ ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਿਆਨ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ; ਡੰਡ ਧਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
Some take to yoga, some to pleasures, some to talk of wisdom, some to trances, and some to carrying the yogi's staff. ॥1॥
ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਪ ਕਾਹੂ ਤਾਪ; ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮ ਨੇਮ ॥ ਕਾਹੂ ਹੋ; ਗਉਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
Some like chants, some austerities, some worship, fire offerings and daily rites, and some roam the earth. ॥2॥
ਕਾਹੂ ਤੀਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਨੀਰ; ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਹੋ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੫੫॥
Some sit on riverbanks, some bathe at pilgrim places, some study the Vedas; but, O Nanak, God loves devotion. ॥3॥2॥155॥
Praising Your virtues is my treasure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰਸ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਜਸ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਰੂਪ ਤੂਹੀ ਰੰਗ ॥ ਆਸ ਓਟ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੧॥
You are my delights, You my honours, You my beauty and my pleasures; O God, You are my hope and shelter. ॥1॥
ਤੂਹੀ ਮਾਨ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਧਾਨ; ਤੂਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਤੂਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥ ਗੁਰਿ; ਤੂਟੀ ਲੈ ਜੋਰੀ ॥੨॥
You are my respect, You my wealth, You my honour, You my life; the Guru has joined my broken attention to You. ॥2॥
ਤੂਹੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ. ਤੂਹੀ ਬਨਿ ਤੂਹੀ; ਗਾਉ ਤੂਹੀ ਸੁਨਿ ॥ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨੇਰ ਨੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੫੬॥
I see You in the home and in the forest, in the village and in the wilderness; O Nanak, God is very near. ॥3॥3॥156॥
214: I too am drunk, drunk on the wine of God's love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਓੁਹੀ ਪੀਓ ਓੁਹੀ ਖੀਓ; ਗੁਰਹਿ ਦੀਓ. ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਓ ॥ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ; ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ॥੧॥
I have drunk that wine of the Name and am drunk on it; the Guru gave it to me as a gift, and my mind is dyed in it. ॥1॥
ਓੁਹੀ ਭਾਠੀ. ਓੁਹੀ ਪੋਚਾ; ਉਹੀ ਪਿਆਰੋ. ਉਹੀ ਰੂਚਾ ॥ ਮਨਿ ਓਹੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਤੋ ॥੨॥
The Name is my still, the Name the cooling cloth, the Name my cup and my longing; in my mind I enjoy that joy. ॥2॥
ਸਹਜ ਕੇਲ ਅਨਦ ਖੇਲ; ਰਹੇ ਫੇਰ. ਭਏ ਮੇਲ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਾਤੋ ॥੩॥੪॥੧੫੭॥
One whose mind is threaded on the Guru's word enjoys the play of stillness, meets God, and his rounds of birth end, O Nanak. ॥3॥4॥157॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ. ਮੀਤਾ ਲੇਹੁ; ਆਗੈ. ਬਿਖਮ ਪੰਥੁ ਭੈਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remember God's Name, friend, remember it; the road you walk is hard and frightening. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੇਵਤ ਸੇਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
Keep remembering God, always remembering; death dwells with you at every moment.
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੂੰ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ; ਹੋ. ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
Serve the Guru, and the net of attachment that brings spiritual death is cut. ॥1॥
ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ; ਬਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ, ਬਧੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
Those who made fire offerings, sacrifices and pilgrimages were caught in pride, and their vices grew.
ਨਰਕੁ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਭੁੰਚਨਾ; ਹੋਇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੨॥
So both hell and heaven have to be undergone, and births come again and again. ॥2॥
ਸਿਵ ਪੁਰੀ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪੁਰੀ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
The worlds of Shiva, Brahma and Indra: none of these places lasts for ever.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ; ਹੋ, ਸਾਕਤ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
Without remembering God there is no peace; those cut off from God keep coming and going. ॥3॥
ਜੈਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਮੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਕਹਿਆ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥
As the Guru taught me, so I have proclaimed it aloud.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ. ਸੁਨਿ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੮॥
Nanak says: listen, O mind, sing God's praise and you are saved. ॥4॥1॥158॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Whoever found peace found it with a child's understanding.
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ. ਹਾਨਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ, ਦੂਖ ਸੁਖ; ਚਿਤਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ. ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
On meeting the Guru, joy and grief, loss and death, pain and pleasure seem alike to the mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਉ ਲਉ. ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋਚਉ ਚਿਤਵਉ; ਤਉ ਲਉ. ਦੁਖਨੁ ਭਰੇ ॥
As long as I kept scheming and planning, I stayed full of pain.
ਜਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਤਉ ਆਨਦ ਸਹਜੇ ॥੧॥
Now that I have met the kind, perfect Guru, I enjoy joy in stillness of mind. ॥1॥
ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਰਮ ਹਉ ਕੀਏ; ਤੇਤੇ ਬੰਧ ਪਰੇ ॥
However many clever deeds I did, so many bonds fell on me.
ਜਉ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਰੁ. ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿਓ; ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ॥੨॥
When the Guru placed his hand on my forehead, I became free. ॥2॥
ਜਉ ਲਉ. ਮੇਰੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਰਤੋ; ਤਉ ਲਉ. ਬਿਖੁ ਘੇਰੇ ॥
As long as I kept saying mine, mine, the poison of Maya held me surrounded.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ. ਅਰਪੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ; ਤਬ ਹਮ. ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਏ ॥੩॥
Now I have given mind, body and intellect over to the Lord, and I rest in stillness. ॥3॥
ਜਉ ਲਉ. ਪੋਟ ਉਠਾਈ ਚਲਿਅਉ; ਤਉ ਲਉ ਡਾਨ ਭਰੇ ॥
As long as I walked carrying the bundle of attachment, I kept paying the penalty of fear.
ਪੋਟ ਡਾਰਿ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਭਏ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੫੯॥
Now I have met the perfect Guru and thrown the bundle down, and Nanak has become fearless. ॥4॥1॥159॥
O sister, I have given up the urge to grasp pleasure and flee pain, given it up,
given it up for good, on meeting the Guru.
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ; ਮਾਨਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੈ ਆਗਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Accepting God's will as sweet, I have every comfort, joy and delight. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
215: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਦੋਊ ਸਮਾਨੇ; ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ. ਗੁਰ ਪਾਗਿਓ ॥
O sister, honour and arrogant treatment both seem alike to me, for I have laid my head at the Guru's feet.
ਸੰਪਤ ਹਰਖੁ ਨ ਆਪਤ ਦੂਖਾ; ਰੰਗੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੧॥
Love for the Lord has taken hold of me; wealth that comes brings no joy now, and hardship brings no pain. ॥1॥
ਬਾਸ ਬਾਸਰੀ ਏਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਉਦਿਆਨ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਗਿਓ ॥
O sister, now I see the one Master in every home, and in the forests too He is what I see.
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ. ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਾਗਿਓ ॥੨॥
By the saint Guru's grace I have ended my wandering; I see the knower of all hearts pervading all, and I have become fearless. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਮਨਿ. ਬੁਰੋ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥
Whatever cause the Creator has brought about no longer seems bad in my mind.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ; ਸੋਇਓ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਓ ॥੩॥
In the company of the holy, by the saints' grace, my mind that slept in Maya has woken. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਓੜਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਪਰਿਓ; ਆਇਓ ਸਰਣਾਗਿਓ ॥
O servant Nanak, say: O Lord, I have come into Your shelter, I have fallen at Your refuge.
ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੇ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਿਓ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੦॥
I delight in Your Name and in the bliss of stillness of mind, and no pain touches me any more. ॥4॥2॥160॥
I have found a ruby, a jewel, within my mind.
ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ. ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥੀਆ; ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My body is calmed and my mind is cooled, for I am absorbed in the true Guru's word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
My hunger for Maya is gone, all my thirst for it is ended, and I have put away every worry,
ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ. ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਧਰਿਓ; ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
for the perfect Guru has placed his hand on my forehead; I have mastered my mind, as if I had won the whole world. ॥1॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਡੋਲਨ ਤੇ. ਅਬ ਚੂਕੇ ॥
I am fulfilled and sated within my heart, and now I have stopped wavering after Maya.
ਅਖੁਟੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਤੋਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ਮੂਕੇ ॥੨॥
The true Guru has given me a treasure that never runs out; it suffers no loss and never comes to an end. ॥2॥
ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਐਸੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
Hear one more wondrous thing, brother: the Guru has given me such understanding
ਲਾਹਿ ਪਰਦਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਜਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਤਉ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
that, since the veil of pride was lifted and I met the Master, envy of others has left my heart. ॥3॥
ਕਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ. ਏਹੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ; ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
This wondrous bliss cannot be told; only the one who has tasted it knows it.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੬੧॥
Says Nanak: the Guru has brought and set the treasure of the Name in my heart, and the light of the eternal Lord has dawned within me. ॥4॥3॥161॥
Only by seeking the refuge of the sovereign Lord is a person saved from Maya's sway.
ਸਰਬ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮੰਡਲ; ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤੇ ਧਰਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The beings of every realm are caught in Maya's round, and falling again and again they sink to a low spiritual state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ; ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਨ ਇਉ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
The pandits go on pondering the Shastras, Simritis and Vedas, but the great souls have said this:
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨ. ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ; ਸੂਖੁ. ਨ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
that without worship of God none crosses over, and without remembrance no one has found peace. ॥1॥
ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਕੀ ਲਖਮੀ ਜੋਰੀ; ਬੂਝਤ ਨਾਹੀ. ਲਹਰੇ ॥
Even if a person gathers the wealth of all three worlds, the waves of greed do not subside.
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ. ਕਹਾ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ; ਫਿਰਤੋ ਪਹਰੇ ਪਹਰੇ ॥੨॥
Without devotion to God, where can he find a steady mind? He wanders after Maya every hour. ॥2॥
ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਕਰਤ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਨ; ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
A person may indulge in many pleasures that charm the mind, yet his craving is never fulfilled.
ਜਲਤੋ ਜਲਤੋ. ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬੂਝਤ; ਸਗਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਥੇ. ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੩॥
He goes on burning in the fire of craving, and it is never quenched; without the Name, all his efforts are in vain. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ; ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
Repeat the Lord's Name, my friend; this is the highest peace, and in it nothing is lacking.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ. ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੬੨॥
Whoever ends his round of birth and death in the company of the holy, Nanak begs the dust of that person's feet. ॥4॥4॥162॥
ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
Who else can make me understand in this way?
Only one who has become the very form of the Creator can explain it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਨਜਾਨਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਨੋ; ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
Caught in ignorance, this being has done something else entirely; he has not remembered God nor striven to hold back from vices.
ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਲੈ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦਉਰਾਇਓ; ਕਵਨ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਧਾ ॥੧॥
He sends this mind running in all ten directions; by what deeds has he come to be bound in Maya? ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਹਉ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
He keeps saying: I am master of my life, body, wealth and land; I own this, and this is mine.
216: ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਇਹ ਪੈਖਰ ਪਏ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੨॥
Through wandering and attachment he sees nothing worthwhile; the hobbles of Maya's attachment are on his feet. ॥2॥
ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਮਾਵਨ ਪਰਿਆ; ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
What could this being earn back when he did not exist at all?
ਜਬ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰਤਾ ॥੩॥
When there was only the one pure, formless Lord, the Lord Himself was the doer of everything. ॥3॥
ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਤਬ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹੁ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
He alone knows His own works, the One who made this creation.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬੩॥
Says Nanak: He alone is the doer of all; the true Guru has removed the delusion of owning anything. ॥4॥5॥163॥
Without remembrance of God, all other religious deeds are in vain.
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ; ਇਹਿ ਓਰੈ ਮੂਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chanting, austerities, disciplines to hold the senses back: all these are snatched away short of God's court. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤਾ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ. ਆਢੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
A person stays busy with fasts, rules and restraints, but gets not even a cowrie's worth for them.
ਆਗੈ ਚਲਣੁ. ਅਉਰੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ; ਊਂਹਾ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
The thing that goes along with you on the road ahead is something else, brother; none of these is of use there. ॥1॥
ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ਅਰੁ ਧਰਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ; ਆਗੈ. ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
One who bathes at pilgrim places and roams the earth as a renunciate finds no place in God's court.
ਊਹਾ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ, ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ; ਓਹੁ ਲੋਗਨ. ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
No such method is of use in the Lord's presence; by it he only convinces people of his piety. ॥2॥
ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨੀ ਉਚਰੈ; ਆਗੈ ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Even if a pandit can recite all four Vedas by heart, he finds no place in the Lord's presence.
ਬੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ. ਏਕੁ ਸੁਧਾਖਰੁ; ਓਹੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਝਾਖ ਝਖਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
One who does not understand the one pure Name brings nothing but ruin upon himself. ॥3॥
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਤੋ. ਇਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ; ਜਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਗਰਾਮੀ ॥
Nanak speaks this one thought: whoever puts it into practice becomes able to cross the world-ocean.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੬੪॥
Take the Guru's refuge and meditate on the Name, and drive the pride out of your mind. ॥4॥6॥164॥
ਮਾਧਉ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ. ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
O Lord, Master of Maya, be kind, so that we may utter Your Name, Hari, Hari, with our mouths.
ਹਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Master, we can do nothing ourselves; as You keep us, so we live. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਕਿ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ; ਕਿਆ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
What can this being do? What is it able to do? What lies in the hands of this poor creature?
ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਮ ਲਾਵਹੁ. ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
O my all-pervading Master, wherever You attach it, there it stays attached. ॥1॥
ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ. ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ; ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
Be kind, O giver to all, and attach me to Your one form alone.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੬੫॥
This is Nanak's prayer to the Lord: make me repeat Your Name. ॥2॥7॥165॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O sovereign Lord, merciful to the poor,
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਾ ਕਰਿ; ਸੇਵ ਲਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
You have made millions Your servants and set them to Your service.
ਭਗਤ ਵਛਲੁ; ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Loving Your devotees has been Your nature from the very beginning.
O Lord, You are present in every place. ॥1॥
ਕਿਉ ਪੇਖਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਕਵਣ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
How may I behold my Beloved? What is the noble deed by which I may see Him?
The answer is that I become the handmaid of the saints and serve at their feet.
ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਵਤਾਈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
I offer this life of mine to the Lord and am a sacrifice to Him again and again.
ਤਿਸੁ; ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Bowing low again and again, I keep falling at His feet. ॥2॥
One becomes a pandit and keeps searching the Vedas and other books,
one turns away from the world and goes bathing at every pilgrim place,
one sings songs, plays music and performs kirtan,
but I keep remembering the Lord's Name, which makes me fearless. ॥3॥
Those on whom my Master is merciful,
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵਿਤ; ਲਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
though fallen into vices, become pure in conduct by clinging to the Guru's feet.
217: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ; ਕੀਏ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Guru removes their wandering and every base fear, and frees them of all enmity.
ਗੁਰ; ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
O Guru, You alone have fulfilled my mind's hope of remembrance. ॥4॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸੋ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
One who has found the wealth of the Name has become rich;
ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸੁ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
one who has remembered the Lord has gained honour here and hereafter.
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਰਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
One who has found the Guru's company has had all his conduct made noble;
O servant Nanak, say: that person is absorbed in stillness of mind. ॥5॥1॥166॥
O my beloved Lord, come and dwell in my heart.
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Night and day, with every breath, I remember You.
ਸੰਤ ਦੇਉ ਸੰਦੇਸਾ; ਪੈ ਚਰਣਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Falling at Your saints' feet, I send You a message:
ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
without You, I cannot cross over in any way. ॥1॥
ਸੰਗਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ; ਮੈ ਕਰੇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
In Your company I enjoy bliss.
ਵਣਿ ਤਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ; ਸੁਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Seeing You in all the vegetation and the three worlds, I know the highest peace and bliss.
ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੰਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
The bed of my heart has become lovely, and this mind of mine has blossomed.
ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਇਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
Beholding Your sight, this peace is gained. ॥2॥
ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ; ਕਰੀ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Be kind, Lord, that I may wash the feet of Your saints and serve them always;
this is my worship of the gods, my offering of flowers and my bowing before them,
ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੇਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
that as the servant of Your servants I keep repeating Your Name.
O saints, this is the prayer I ask you to speak to the Master for me. ॥3॥
ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮੇਰੀ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
My wish is fulfilled; my mind has come alive spiritually and my body is green again.
ਦਰਸਨ ਪੇਖਤ; ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਪਰਹਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Beholding the Beloved, all my pain is gone.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Repeating the Lord's Name again and again, I have crossed the world-ocean.
ਇਹੁ ਅਜਰੁ. ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਹੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੬੭॥
O Nanak, one enjoys this peace that never wanes. ॥4॥2॥167॥
ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਜਨ; ਮਨ ਮਿਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Listen, listen, O dear Friend, O Friend of my mind.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਭਿ. ਵਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
This mind and body are Your gift, and this life too; I offer them all to You.
ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਅਧਾਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, prop of my life, do not forget me.
May I remain in Your refuge for ever. ॥1॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ; ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Brother, the Lord by meeting whom the mind comes alive spiritually,
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ; ਸੋ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
that Lord is found only by the Guru's grace.
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Everything is the Lord's gift, and every place is the Lord's;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
I am for ever a sacrifice to the Lord. ॥2॥
This Name is a treasure; some fortunate person repeats it,
ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
and his love becomes fixed on the Name of the pure Lord alone.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
One who finds the perfect Guru rids himself of every pain,
and sings the Lord's praises all eight watches. ॥3॥
ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, Your Name is the source of precious things like jewels.
ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ; ਭਗਤੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
You are the eternal banker of them, and Your devotee is the trader in them.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ; ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
The wealth of Your Name is his capital, and this eternal trade is what he deals in.
O servant Nanak, say: I am for ever a sacrifice to You. ॥4॥3॥168॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਤੇ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
O Creator, You are my great pride; You are my honour.
ਜੋਰਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੈ. ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By Your strength I dwell in peace; the word of Your eternal praise is my pass on life's journey. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਜਾਤੀਆ; ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਚੁਪ ਕੀਆ ॥
A person caught in Maya hears and understands all the talk of the higher life, yet pays it no heed.
ਕਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਨ ਲਧੀਆ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੜਿਆ ॥੧॥
Enticed by Maya, he never turns his attention to it. ॥1॥
ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਰਤ ਸਾਰਤਾ; ਸੇ ਅਖੀ ਡਿਠੜਿਆ ॥
If a Gurmukh gives a hint or a riddle that none stays here, we see it with our own eyes too,
218: ਕੋਈ ਜਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ; ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
yet a person is such a foolish, greedy creature that he does not listen to what is said at all. ॥2॥
ਇਕਸੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ; ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਠੀ ॥
What can I say of one, two or four? The whole world is being cheated by the one same taste.
ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ. ਨਾਇ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ; ਕਾ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
Rare is the one who relishes the Name; rare is the heart that has been made to flourish. ॥3॥
ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ; ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
The devotees shine at the eternal Lord's door and enjoy spiritual bliss day and night.
ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
O servant Nanak, say: I am a sacrifice to those dyed in the love of the Supreme Lord. ॥4॥1॥169॥
ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ. ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ; ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ. ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
O Lord, Your Name destroys sorrow; Your Name destroys sorrow.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It should be remembered all eight watches: this is the perfect true Guru's teaching, which brings a deep bond with God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
The heart in which the Supreme Lord comes to dwell becomes a beautiful place.
ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ. ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
Death's messenger does not come near one who sings the Lord's virtues with his tongue. ॥1॥
ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ. ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ; ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
I did not know the worth of understanding Your service, nor did it occur to me to worship You,
ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ; ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
but now I have taken Your shelter, O life of the world, O my Master, unreachable and unfathomable. ॥2॥
ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ; ਨਠੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
Those on whom the Master of creation is merciful have all their worry and suffering driven away.
ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ. ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
No hot wind touches the one whom the true Guru himself protects. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ. ਦਯੁ ਗੁਰੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
The Guru is the form of Narayan, the Guru is the merciful Lord, the Guru is the eternal Creator.
ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ. ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
When the Guru is pleased, everything is gained; O servant Nanak, say: I am for ever a sacrifice to the Guru. ॥4॥2॥170॥
Repeating always the Name of the Lord, Ram, Ram,
all one's tasks are fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪੇਦਿਆ; ਹੋਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
Repeating Ram, Gobind, the mouth becomes pure.
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ; ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥੧॥
He alone is a true brother and friend from whom one hears the Lord's praise. ॥1॥
ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਫਲਾ; ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
He in whose power are all things, all fruits and all spiritual virtues,
ਕਿਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
that Gobind should never be forgotten, by remembering whom all sorrows go. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਗਿਐ ਜੀਵੀਐ; ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਈਐ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
Holding to whose hem one comes alive spiritually and crosses the world-ocean,
ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
by remembering whom in the Guru's company one is saved from vices and stands honoured in the Lord's court. ॥3॥
ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ; ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
Praise of the Lord of the world gives spiritual life; it is the capital of the saints.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
O Nanak, repeating the Name they are saved, and win acclaim at the eternal Lord's door. ॥4॥3॥171॥
ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ, ਗਾਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ; ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
O my soul, sing the Lord's sweet virtues; keep singing the Lord's sweet virtues.
ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Dyed in the eternal Lord, even one who had no place finds honour everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹੋਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ; ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
All other tastes are insipid, and in them body and mind grow dry.
ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ; ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Whatever one does apart from the Supreme Lord makes that life worthy of reproach. ॥1॥
ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ; ਤਰਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
Holding the Guru's hem, one can cross this world-ocean.
The Supreme Lord should be worshipped; the whole family of one who does so is saved. ॥2॥
ਸਾਜਨੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੋ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
He alone is a true friend, kinsman and companion who gives the Lord's Name to keep in the heart,
ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ; ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
for he removes all our faults and does us good. ॥3॥
ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਘਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
The Lord's feet are the treasure: they are wealth, store, dwelling and home.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ. ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
O Lord, Nanak, a beggar at Your door, begs the gift of Your Name. ॥4॥4॥172॥
219: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O saints, give up the pride of your minds.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ. ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Lust and anger are like the company of the wicked; keep away from them day and night. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ. ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ; ਅਉਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥
One who holds pleasure and pain both alike, and honour and dishonour too,
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ. ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
and stays detached from joy and grief, has grasped the secret of life in this world. ॥1॥
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ; ਖੋਜੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
One who gives up both flattery and slander and seeks the state free of craving has found the truth.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ; ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
O servant Nanak, this game of life is hard; only a rare one understands it by taking the Guru's refuge. ॥2॥1॥
O saints, the Lord has made such a creation
ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ. ਇਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ; ਅਚਰਜੁ. ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that one person dies while another takes himself to be lasting for ever; this wonder cannot be described. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਹਰਿ; ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
A person stays in the grip of lust, anger and attachment, and forgets God's very being.
ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ. ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ; ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
He takes this passing body to be lasting, as one takes a dream at night to be real. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ; ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਈ ॥
Whatever is seen passes away in its time, like the shade of a cloud.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਿਥਿਆ; ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be perishable stays in the Lord's refuge. ॥2॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ. ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
A person does not bring the Lord's praise to dwell in his mind.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ; ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Day and night he stays engrossed in Maya; say, how can he sing God's virtues? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਿਉ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
He is bound by possessive love of sons, friends and wealth, and so ties himself up.
ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ, ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ; ਦੇਖਿ ਤਾਸਿ. ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
This world is false like a mirage, yet seeing it he keeps running after it. ॥1॥
ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮੂੜ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
The fool forgets the Master who is the giver of the world's pleasures and of liberation as well.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕੋਊ; ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
O servant Nanak, say: among millions, rare is the one who attains devotion to the Lord. ॥2॥3॥
ਸਾਧੋ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹਿਓ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
O saints, this mind cannot be held in check,
ਚੰਚਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ; ਯਾ ਤੇ. ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for it lives with fickle craving, and so it never stays steady. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਠਨ ਕਰੋਧ. ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
Uncontrollable anger also dwells within this heart, and it has made a person forget all good sense.
ਰਤਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ. ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
It has stolen the jewel of wisdom from everyone, and no one can prevail against it. ॥1॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰੇ; ਗੁਨੀ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
All the yogis grew weary of their efforts, and the learned grew weary of praising their learning.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ; ਤਉ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੨॥੪॥
O servant Nanak, when the Lord is merciful, then every means falls into place. ॥2॥4॥
O saints, keep singing the virtues of Gobind.
ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You have been given this priceless human birth; why waste it in vain? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪੁਨੀਤ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਰਿ; ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਆਵਉ ॥
The Lord purifies even those fallen into vices and is the helper of the poor; you too should come to His refuge.
ਗਜ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was ended; why do you forget Him? ॥1॥
ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ; ਫੁਨਿ ਭਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
Give up pride and attachment to Maya, and fix your mind on worship of the Lord.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਹੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
Says Nanak: this is the path of freedom from vices, but you will find it only by taking the Guru's refuge. ॥2॥5॥
O mother, may someone counsel my mind that has gone astray.
220: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ. ਸਾਧ ਮਗ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਰਿ; ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Even after hearing the Vedas, the Puranas and the counsel of the saints, this mind does not sing God's praises for a moment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥
Though it has gained the human body, so hard to come by, it lets this life slip away in vain.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ, ਮਹਾ ਸੰਕਟ ਬਨ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਰੁਚ ਉਪਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
The world is a jungle crammed with attachment to Maya, and my mind keeps forming a love for it. ॥1॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਤਾ ਸਿਉ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
God dwells within and without every being at all times, yet my mind does not set its love on Him.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੬॥
O Nanak, know that release is won only by the one in whose heart God dwells. ॥2॥6॥
O saints, peace from wandering in vices comes only by taking refuge in God.
ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪੜੇ ਕੋ ਇਹ ਗੁਨ; ਸਿਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The true gain of reading the Vedas and Puranas is that one keeps remembering God's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ. ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ; ਅਉ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
Greed, attachment to Maya, possessiveness and indulgence in the senses,
ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਪਰਸੈ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਸੋ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
joy and grief: the one whom none of these can touch is the very image of God. ॥1॥
ਸੁਰਗ ਨਰਕ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਖੁ, ਏ ਸਭ; ਤਿਉ ਕੰਚਨ ਅਰੁ ਪੈਸਾ ॥
He to whom heaven and hell, nectar and poison seem alike, to whom gold and copper are the same,
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਏ ਸਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੨॥
in whose heart praise and slander are equal, and on whom neither greed nor attachment has any hold. ॥2॥
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ. ਏ ਬਾਧੇ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਤਿਹ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਉ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Know as one in deep union with God the person whom neither pain nor pleasure can bind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਉ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
O Nanak, take that person to be released who lives his life in this way. ॥3॥7॥
ਮਨ ਰੇ; ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
O my mind, why have you gone mad, caught in greed?
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੈ; ਭਇਓ ਲੋਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Day and night life wears away, yet a person does not see it, and caught in greed his spiritual life grows weak. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੋ ਤਨੁ ਤੈ ਅਪਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ; ਅਰੁ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
The body you take to be your own, and the beautiful wife of your house you count as yours:
ਇਨ ਮੈਂ. ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਨਿ; ਦੇਖੋ ਸੋਚ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
none of these is a lasting companion of yours; think it over and see. ॥1॥
ਰਤਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਪਨੋ. ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Like a gambler losing his stake, you are losing your precious human life, for you have not valued the state of union with God.
ਨਿਮਖ. ਨ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਚਰਨਨ ਸਿਂਉ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
You do not join yourself to the Lord's feet even for a moment, and you pass your life in vain. ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Says Nanak: that person alone lives in peace who repeats God's Name and sings His praises.
ਅਉਰ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ; ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੮॥
The rest of the world, caught in attachment to Maya, never reaches the state where no fear can touch it. ॥3॥8॥
ਨਰ; ਅਚੇਤ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਡਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
O heedless person, keep yourself from sin,
ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ; ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and stay in the refuge of God, who is kind to the poor and removes every fear. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਾਸ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ. ਹੀਐ ਮੋ ਧਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
Thread into your heart the Name of the One whose virtues the Vedas and Puranas sing.
ਪਾਵਨ ਨਾਮੁ. ਜਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ; ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਕਸਮਲ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Only God's Name purifies in this world; remember Him again and again and rid yourself of every sin. ॥1॥
ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਵੈ; ਕਛੂ ਉਪਾਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਰੁ ਰੇ ॥
You will not find this human body again; make some effort now to win release.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਗਾਇ ਕਰੁਨਾ ਮੈ; ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੫੧॥
Says Nanak to you: sing the praises of the compassionate Lord and cross the ocean of the world. ॥2॥9॥251॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ॥
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
God's spotless Name is my treasure, and reflecting on His virtues is my miraculous power.
Now I see God pervading every place, and I have killed the poison of Maya within me.
Absorbed in the pure Name, my inner irritation has ended.
